text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Champions Cup
held at Chukyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This venue, also home to popular turf races, recorded an attendance on this day that pushed its capacity to the absolute limit—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That massive cheer reached all the way to Smart Falcon in the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
S-Somehow... Falco is, like...!
Super nervous right now!?
choice_data_list: Why are you phrasing it like a question?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I mean, it's been so long since I felt like this~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I was in such great shape, so what
am I gonna do if I stumble now of all times?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
With a roar like that from the crowd...
What if Falco doesn't win...!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-san.
I've calmed down a bit!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: “You're right. Today... I won't forget my desire to truly shine.”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco's gonna go out there
and sparkle with all her might!
